reviewed_exact_row: 30002714 / OWR-13351-013: Must the complete integral closure of a total blow-up B∞(R,v) along a centered valuation be a valuation ring? Original Schoutens OWR 49/2014 pp.2805–2806: https://ems.press/content/serial-article-files/46540

Ideal theory of infinite directed unions of local quadratic transforms — William Heinzer, K. Alan Loper, Bruce Olberding, Hans Schoutens and Matthew Toeniskoetter; Journal of Algebra 474 (2017),213–239. Prior full negative answer: Example 7.2 and Theorem 6.9 give a nonarchimedean total blow-up whose complete integral closure is R_(y,z), a two-dimensional regular local ring containing neither y/z nor z/y. The valuation/transforms and closure calculation remain inside the original fraction field. Source credits Shannon 1973 Example 4.7; no earliest-priority or project-authorship claim. Inspected arXiv:1505.06445v3; final journal body uninspected. No rank-one or archimedean counterexample claimed. Existing publication; audit: https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/1145
